Goshen City Dedza Dynamos Dissolves Executive Committee

By Face of MalawiPublished September 29, 2026 at 13:41
Share this storyFacebookXWhatsApp

Goshen City Dedza Dynamos has dissolved its executive committee as part of a restructuring exercise aimed at strengthening the club’s administration.

In a letter signed by the club’s patron, Lewis Msukwa, the team says the decision is intended to ensure continuity and maintain its professional trajectory.

The club says it will soon establish a board of directors that will take over the governance and administration of the team.

Sports analyst Twaha Chimuka has welcomed the development, describing the restructuring as a positive step towards strengthening the club’s administrative structures.
